expectedPublicationDelay.delayDescription: Because of reporting delays, there is a gap of at least 56 day(s) between the publication date and published data.

temporalVariables.columnDescription: Temporal information of the value specified in the property 'valueCategory'.
temporalVariables.typeColumnDescription: Specifies the type of temporal value in the property 'temporal'.

georegion.columnDescription: Geographical unit of the data record.
georegion.typeColumnDescription: Specifies the type of geographical unit in the property 'georegion'.

value.description: Represents the value defined by the property 'valueCategory' within the given temporal unit and grouping.

valueYearCumSum.description: Cumulative sum of the property 'value' within a year.

pop.description: Population number within the given temporal unit and grouping.

incValue.description: Incidence value within the given temporal unit and grouping. Based on non-rounded figures of value and pop.

deltaValue.description: Absolute difference in the metric 'value' comparing the current year to the last one.

deltaIncValue.description: Absolute difference in the metric 'incValue' comparing the current year to the last one.

incValuePrctChange.description: Percentage difference in the metric 'incValue' comparing the current year to the last one.

valueMean5y.description: Right-aligned, rolling 5-year average of the property 'value'.

trend.description: Indicates a trend of an entry with respect to previous entries. The trend is calculated using a poisson and poisson glm with a log-link with a right-aligned window of size 4 and 4 for the temporal_type year and month, respectively. For data by year the trend is adjusted by population size. For data by month the trend is not adjusted by population size.
